description_en: Updates a knowledge base synchronization link
kebab_example: aliyun polardb update-kb-sync-link --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --knowledge-base-id pkb-xxxxx --link-id pkbl-xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateKBSyncLink

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization link
parameters.name: link_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic synchronization. This parameter must be modified individually and cannot be changed along with other configurations
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用自动同步，仅支持单独修改，不可与其他配置同时变更
parameters.name: sync_enabled

parameters.help_en: The new Lark user access token
parameters.help_zh: 新的飞书用户访问令牌
parameters.name: user_access_token

parameters.help_en: The new Lark user refresh token. Pass this parameter together with UserAccessToken. Passing empty strings for both parameters indicates deletion
parameters.help_zh: 新的飞书用户刷新令牌；与 UserAccessToken 同时传入，两个空字符串表示删除
parameters.name: user_refresh_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DingTalk user that performs the operation
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of a successful Lark group member snapshot used for fallback reuse, in seconds. This parameter can be explicitly set only for FEISHU synchronization links. A value of -1 indicates that the snapshot never expires. A value of 0 disables snapshot fallback reuse. A positive integer indicates the maximum age of a snapshot allowed for reuse. If this parameter is omitted, the original value is retained. Explicitly passing -1 restores the default behavior
parameters.help_zh: 飞书群成员成功快照用于降级复用的有效期，单位为秒。仅 FEISHU 同步链路可显式设置；-1 表示永不过期，0 表示禁用快照降级复用，正整数表示允许复用的快照最大年龄；省略时保持原值，显式传入 -1 可恢复默认行为
parameters.name: feishu_chat_member_stale_ttl_seconds

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the DingTalk Docs MCP server
parameters.help_zh: 钉钉文档 MCP Server 地址
parameters.name: mcp_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the DingTalk Sheets MCP server
parameters.help_zh: 钉钉表格 MCP Server 地址
parameters.name: sheet_mcp_endpoint

LinkId.description_en: The ID of the synchronization link

SyncSchedule.description_en: The schedule time of the synchronization task
